query:
SELECT 
  o.shopName AS 商鋪,
  op.sku AS SKU,
  op.productName AS 產品名稱,
  op.color AS 顏色,
  o.orderNumber AS 訂單號,
  o.customerName AS 客戶姓名,
  o.deliveryDate AS 送貨日期,
  o.status AS 狀態,
  op.quantity AS 數量
FROM orderProducts op
JOIN orders o ON op.orderId = o.id
WHERE (op.productName LIKE '%UP920%' OR op.productName LIKE '%UP911%' OR op.sku LIKE '%UP920%' OR op.sku LIKE '%UP911%')
  AND op.isGift = 'no'
  AND o.status NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled')
  AND o.deliveryDate > '2026-06-16'
ORDER BY o.shopName, op.sku, o.deliveryDate
LIMIT 30 OFFSET 30;
